rationale: Tests classification of monosaccharides by functional group and carbon number, the epimer relationship, and reducing-sugar status — the core classification learning point completed in block 4.
Tests spatial identification of the four key membrane transporters on a small-intestinal enterocyte, the central visual-spatial learning point of carbohydrate absorption in block 5.

Tests recall of PDH coenzymes, TCA cycle rate-limiting enzyme, substrate-level phosphorylation product and enzyme poison — the core factual learning points closing the PDH and TCA cycle section in block 7.
Tests the ordered kinase cascade from glucagon receptor binding to glycogen cleavage — the key signalling sequence that closes the glycogen metabolism learning point in block 10.
Tests recall of the key enzymes, accumulated metabolites and clinical consequences of fructose, galactose and polyol pathway disorders — the learning point closed in block 14.
Tests the learner's ability to identify specific biochemical and clinical abnormalities resulting from absolute insulin deficiency — the pathophysiology learning point closed in block 19.
Tests recall of pre-analytical precautions, laboratory methods and diagnostic thresholds for diabetes — the laboratory investigation learning point closed in block 20.
